extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking literary representation / authors querying agents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors submitting fiction or nonfiction to William Morris Endeavor (WME): what the agency seeks and how to approach contacting an agent given the lack of on-site submission guidelines. Emphasizes researching individual agents and querying first after locating contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Needs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WME represents authors among a variety of artists; these are the broad categories the agency is noted as seeking in this listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tips (agent research)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are interviews with several WME agents available online including Dorian Karchmar, Eric Simonoff, Jay Mandel and Claudia Ballard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: read agent interviews to learn individual agent preferences and approaches before querying. The page lists specific agents to look up.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Submit (query-first approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: WME does not have agent contact specifics or guidelines on its site. As with most agencies you should query first after tracking down the contact information for the agent you are interested in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit submission instruction: locate the agent's contact information elsewhere and send a query first. There are no site-specific formatting or packet requirements provided here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency scope / representation
rubrics_metrics.description: William Morris Endeavor was founded in April 2009 ... WME is one of the world's top talent agencies and represents a variety of artists, including authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual guidance: WME is a large, full-service talent agency representing many kinds of clients, so authors should be aware they are approaching a broad commercial agency rather than a niche literary-only firm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact address (office location)
rubrics_metrics.description: Address: 11 Madison Avenue  New York NY 10010
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical office address is provided; the listing does not say whether unsolicited mailed materials are accepted, so use this address only after confirming current submission/contact policies elsewhere.
